name: science-centre-303s
estimated: some heights, with a photograph as a reference; the places, sizes and spacing of the fins on its face to the street; the braces between the last fin and the pier at the corner; the spandrel bands on its south-east end and the storey's height; the glazing from the street's level; and the colour of the walls no photograph shows
refs_note: the folder of refs/ that holds the reference views (views.json, masks/), which refine, compare, metrics, sky_mask and the viewer's ?sv= read: refs/photos (gitignored), whose views tools/photo_camera.py writes. Its one photograph is taken from the street about 95 m to the south-east through a long lens (a horizontal field of 32 degrees); its camera is fitted with the principal point at the centre.

building.title: Science Centre (303S), University of Auckland
building.note: outline: building 303S's outer ring from the main project's campus.json, in the map's frame; it chooses the crop box and the building's own points (frame.near_outline, measure and topview). The site replaces block 303S by its id.

origin.note: the campus origin, as in campus.json; the landmark's local metres = NZTM (EPSG:2193) minus the NZTM of this point, with grid north

door.note: the entrance is not known: the photograph hides the ground storey behind the street's railing and the campus map records none; so the door is on the pavement before the face to the street, 39% along it from its north-west end, 1.8 m out from it (u 23, w 2.0 from the face's line in the building's frame, the drawn face at w 0.2), where the LiDAR's ground is the frame's (13 returns within 1 m, p10/p50/p90 -0.048/0.002/0.049 m); the pavement rises along the face, from 1.85 m below it at the north-west tip to 2.6 m above it at the south-east end

aerial.licence: Auckland Central 0.06 m Urban Aerial Photos (2023): sourced from LINZ and licensed by Auckland Council for re-use under CC BY 4.0

frame.method: LiDAR building points (class 6) more than min_above m above the ground and within near_outline m of building.outline

ground_note: 39.3 m: the median LiDAR ground (class 2) in the first crop, 25 m round the outline (p5 36.7, p95 42.2: the site falls about 5.5 m), and the LiDAR's ground at the door
crop_note: 135 m round the outline, so that the crop takes in the photograph's camera, on the street about 95 m to the south-east, and tools/photo_camera.py holds it at a hand's height above the LiDAR's ground there; the frame comes from the points near the outline and is the same as with 25 m

light.note: estimated: the photograph is taken on a clear day with the sun high to the north, which leaves the face to the street (to the south-west) and the south-east end, the faces it shows, in shade; so the viewer's sun stands at 20 deg round and 60 deg up; the exposure from the building's luma: p10/p50/p90 96/131/188 at 1.4 against the photograph's 87/130/190 (112 at the default 1.0, 150 at 1.8)
